holidays.name: Birthday of Martin Luther King, Jr.

business_days.note: A business day is any calendar day except Sunday or any federal holiday. The federal holidays are those of 5 U.S.C. 6103(a). A holiday on a Saturday also takes the Friday before out of the count, and one on a Sunday the Monday after, which never gives an earlier deadline.

count_from.note: The rule counts from the date of the transaction. The app counts from the later of that day and the day the buyer received the signed copy, so its deadline is never earlier than the rule's.

language.rule: The agreement, the statement and the Notice of Cancellation are in the same language as the oral sales presentation.

statement.what: The statement next to the buyer's signature, in bold of at least 10 points.

cancellation_form.what: The completed Notice of Cancellation, given in duplicate and easily detachable.

applies.rule: A sale of consumer goods or services of $25 or more made at the buyer's residence, or of $130 or more at another place that is not the seller's place of business, where the seller personally solicits it.

exemptions.rule: Some sales are outside the rule: for example real property, insurance and securities; sales made entirely by mail or telephone; a bona fide emergency where the buyer waives the right in their own handwriting; and a sale after prior negotiations at the seller's fixed place of business. These are listed for your lawyer, never applied by the app on its own.

flags.text: Tell the buyer out loud about the right to cancel at the time they sign.
The agreement may not include a confession of judgment or any waiver of the buyer's rights under the rule, including the right to cancel.
After a valid cancellation: within 10 business days refund every payment, return any trade-in, cancel any security interest, and tell the buyer whether you will pick up delivered goods.
Don't sell or assign the buyer's note or other evidence of debt before midnight of the fifth business day after the sale.
Only when you finance a sale and take a security interest in the buyer's principal dwelling: a separate right of rescission for 3 business days, with a notice to each owner, may apply.
